title: Citrate Synthase Activity Assay
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.rq4d5yw

steps.title: Isolate mitochondria from larvae
steps.instruction: Isolate intact mitochondria from female third‑instar wandering larvae for use in the citrate synthase assay.

steps.title: Configure plate reader settings
steps.instruction: Set the plate reader to read at 412 nm using a kinetic program with a total duration of 1.5 minutes and a measurement interval of 10 seconds.

steps.title: Add mitochondria to assay wells
steps.instruction: Transfer 93 µL of the isolated mitochondrial suspension into each well of a 96‑well plate to obtain a final mitochondrial protein concentration of 2.0 µg/mL.

steps.title: Add Acetyl‑CoA and DTNB reagents
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of Acetyl‑CoA (30 mM) and 1 µL of DTNB (10 mM) to each well.

steps.title: Measure baseline absorbance
steps.instruction: Record the absorbance of the reaction mixture for 1.5 minutes to establish the baseline (endogenous thiol or deacetylase activity).

steps.title: Initiate reaction with oxaloacetate
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL of oxaloacetate (10 mM) to each well to start the citrate synthase reaction, using a multichannel pipette to add to all wells as simultaneously as possible.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 5 µL oxaloacetate (10 mM) into each well.

steps.title: Mix and record final absorbance
steps.instruction: Shake the plate for 10 seconds, then continue kinetic absorbance reading at 412 nm; use the molar extinction coefficient for DTNB of 13.6 L·mol⁻¹·cm⁻¹ for activity calculation.
